description.describe_ch: 將策略行銷的核心概念與實務上的運作整合。從內外部環境分析至如何設定行銷策略目標,區隔市場,目標市場設定後,4Ps的整合行銷執行。課程教學法採用個案分析法，透過多元角度分析帶出重點並找出有創意的雙贏解決方案。
description.describe_eh: This course explores the core concepts of strategic marketing, implementation, and their integration in practical operations. It aims to take aspects such as internal and external environmental analysis, setting marketing strategy objectives, market segmentation, setting the target market and the execution of the 4Ps. Additionally, it focuses on how to respond to competitors in the market place. The teaching method uses case analysis taking diversified perspectives to find key points and creative win-win solutions.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: This is a heavy case discussion class, so all students are required to attend. Missing three weeks of classes means failing the course.
Students' participation means answering or asking questions during the class or case discussion (the more you participated the higher the grade)
There are mid-term (internal & external environment analyses, setting marketing objectives and STP) and final presentations (including the mid-term plus the 4Ps). Each account for 15%.
Reading and summarizing each case into an assignment before class is critical for class discussion.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates and teachers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
1.	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2.	All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3.	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4.	You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5.	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6.	Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile/smart phones are turned off during class and put away and keep silent.
7.	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Thank you for your cooperation!

policy.course_pol:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates and teachers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
1.	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
2.	All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
3.	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
4.	You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
5.	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
6.	Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile/smart phones are turned off during class and put away and keep silent.
7.	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Thank you for your cooperation!

policy.ais_meno: Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. In all your work, you may cite words or ideas written by others in publications, websites, or other sources, provided you cite the source. Original work is my bottom line, plagiarized work will receive a "0" or "fail" score. If you are repeat offenders, you will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
